_note: Slugs listed in "gated" require a username and password. Credentials are NEVER stored here. Each gated slug reads one Railway environment variable named GATE_<SLUG_UPPERCASED_UNDERSCORED> whose value is "username:password". Example: slug acme-partnership-0726 reads GATE_ACME_PARTNERSHIP_0726. If a slug is listed here but its variable is missing or malformed, access is DENIED (403) — it is never served open. Leave "gated" empty for a fully open server.
